mapper.sql: a.id as activity_id, v.version_id, v.version as published_version, a.slug as preset_scene_id, s.slug as space_id, v.title_zh as title, v.summary_zh as summary, v.scene_tag_en as scene_tag, v.coach_tip_zh as coach_tip, v.sort_order, v.generation_brief
mapper.select: select from practice_activities a join practice_spaces s on s.id = a.space_id join practice_preset_scene_versions v on v.version_id = a.current_published_version_id and v.activity_id = a.id where v.state = 'published' and v.enabled = true order by v.sort_order asc, a.slug asc, a.id asc, v.version_id asc

select from practice_activities a join practice_spaces s on s.id = a.space_id join practice_preset_scene_versions v on v.version_id = a.current_published_version_id and v.activity_id = a.id where a.slug = #{presetSceneId} and v.state = 'published' and v.enabled = true
